newsitem.title: UK: Europeans see cotton inquiry from Brazil, Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Europeans see cotton inquiry from Brazil, Turkey.

text.p: Some European traders report that the main importing enquiry continues to be found in Brazil and Turkey.
Customers in Europe appear to be generally disinclined to pay merchants' current asking rates for cotton for shipment during the immediate post-summer holiday period.
The firmness of these prices is attributed to a decline in traders' uncommitted stocks and lack of fresh sources of supply from which they might be replenished ahead of the movement of new crops.
